description: Azure Key Vault with optional private endpoint.

access_policies.description: (Optional) List of access_policy. Ignored when enable_rbac_authorization is true.
access_policies.title: Access policies

enable_rbac_authorization.description: (Optional) Whether Azure Active Directory RBAC should be used for authorization of data actions instead of access policies.
enable_rbac_authorization.title: Enable rbac authorization

name.description: (Required) Specifies the name of the Key Vault. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Key Vault Name

network_acls.description: (Optional) Network ACL configuration for the Key Vault. Leave as null to skip configuring network ACLs.
network_acls.title: Network acls

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed for this Key Vault.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public Network Access

purge_protection_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether purge protection is enabled for this Key Vault.
purge_protection_enabled.title: Purge Protection

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the Key Vault. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource Group

sku_name.description: (Optional) The Name of the SKU used for this Key Vault. Possible values are standard and premium.
sku_name.title: SKU

soft_delete_retention_days.description: (Optional) The number of days that items should be retained for once soft-deleted. Valid values are between 7 and 90.
soft_delete_retention_days.title: Soft Delete Retention (days)

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

tenant_id.description: (Optional) The Azure Active Directory tenant ID used for authenticating requests to the Key Vault. Defaults to the tenant of the configured provider when not set.
tenant_id.title: Tenant ID

title: Key Vault
